lines.text: Cover a two by six board with dominoes. Thirteen ways.
lines.caption: Cover a two by six board with dominoes. Thirteen ways.

lines.text: Now add L tiles. How many ways?
lines.caption: Now add L tiles. How many ways?

lines.text: Cover a two by six board with dominoes and L-shaped tiles.
lines.caption: Cover a two by six board with dominoes and L-shaped tiles.

lines.text: How many ways? Pick one of the five choices.
lines.caption: How many ways? Pick one of the five choices.

lines.text: Here's the trick. An L in the top-left corner starts a zigzag.
lines.caption: Here's the trick. An L in the top-left corner starts a zigzag.

lines.text: An L, then lying dominoes, then another L. It's three to six long.
lines.caption: An L, then lying dominoes, then another L. It's three to six long.

lines.text: Each zigzag has a mirror twin, so we count them twice.
lines.caption: Each zigzag has a mirror twin, so we count them twice.

lines.text: Fill a table from short boards, and it grows to fifty-three.
lines.caption: Fill a table from short boards, and it grows to fifty-three.

lines.text: That's Choice C. Without L tiles, it was only thirteen!
lines.caption: That's Choice C. Without L tiles, it was only thirteen!

lines.text: Why exactly that? The full lesson shows two ways, plus every trap.
lines.caption: Why exactly that? The full lesson shows two ways, plus every trap.
